visualCharacteristics: Full-screen sign-in screen: logo, greeting heading, SSO sign-in button, hidden e-mail/password texts, disclaimer link, over a background photo.
contentPattern: Rows classified by content: picture-only rows (first = logo, later = background), a heading row (greeting), the first link row (sign-in label, intro text and SSO link), a later link row (disclaimer, opens in new tab), and a row of plain paragraphs (e-mail login texts, kept hidden).
reuseGuidance: Only for the sign-in page; not a general form block.
